description: This Java class represents pagination data for handling paginated views or data retrieval in a web application, including page size, current page, total count, and navigation methods.

classes.name: PaginationData
classes.description: A POJO class encapsulating pagination details such as page size, current page, total count, and navigation methods for pagination control.

methods.name: PaginationData
methods.description: Constructor initializing page size and current page with validation.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Returns the number of results per page.

methods.name: getPageNumber
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current page number based on offset and page size.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Calculates the starting index (offset) for the current page in a 0-based index system.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Creates and returns a new PaginationData object for the next page.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Creates and returns a new PaginationData object for the previous page.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of results.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of results.

methods.name: getTotalPages
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pages based on total count and page size.
